parameters.content:
## Who is this for?
Agencies that need an auditable record of Lindo website changes without storing another identical backup every week.

## How it works
The workflow retrieves all API-visible pages for one website, validates completeness, normalizes editable content and hashes each page with SHA256. It compares these fingerprints with the last successfully delivered baseline and identifies added, changed and removed pages. Changed runs upload a dated JSON content snapshot to private Google Drive and email a readable change report. Unchanged runs skip both actions. The first active run creates an initial baseline. State advances only after upload and email succeed.

## Setup
1. Configure website ID, private Drive folder, sender and reviewer in Configure archive.
2. Connect Lindo HTTP Header Auth, Google Drive OAuth and SMTP.
3. Run manually to inspect the archive, then activate the Monday 09:00 UTC schedule.
4. Verify two scheduled runs: baseline first, then change a test page and confirm the report.

## Requirements and limits
Built-in nodes only. Workflow static data persists after successful active executions, not manual tests; keep runs sequential. Use a database for concurrent workloads. Limits: 1000 page fingerprints and 20 MB per archive. Only agentic pages exposed by the API are covered, excluding blogs, media files, DNS and history. This is a content archive, not automatic restore. Empty HTML or incomplete inventories stop the run. A delivery failure may repeat the archive on retry. Customize the schedule and reporting destination; keep exported content private.

parameters.jsCode: function canonical(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(canonical);if(v&&typeof v==='object')return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).sort().map(k=>[k,canonical(v[k])]));return v;}return $input.all().map(i=>{const p=i.json.result;if(i.json.success!==true||!p?.page_id||typeof p.html!=='string'||!p.html.trim())throw new Error('Missing or empty page HTML; no baseline will be changed.');return {json:{page_id:p.page_id,path:p.path||'/',name:p.name||p.page_id,canonical:JSON.stringify(canonical({html:p.html,path:p.path,name:p.name,seo:p.seo,settings:p.settings,custom_codes:p.custom_codes}))}};});

nodes.name: Compare with the last delivered snapshot

parameters.jsCode: const id=$('Configure archive').first().json.websiteId;const previous=$getWorkflowStaticData('global').contentBaselines?.[id];const next={};const added=[],changed=[],removed=[];for(const i of $input.all()){const p=i.json;if(!p.contentHash)throw new Error('Missing content hash');next[p.page_id]={hash:p.contentHash,path:p.path,name:p.name};if(!previous?.pages[p.page_id])added.push(p.name+' ('+p.path+')');else if(previous.pages[p.page_id].hash!==p.contentHash)changed.push(p.name+' ('+p.path+')');}if(Object.keys(next).length>1000)throw new Error('State limit: use a database for more than 1000 pages.');for(const [pid,p]of Object.entries(previous?.pages||{}))if(!next[pid])removed.push(p.name+' ('+p.path+')');const initial=!previous;const shouldArchive=initial||added.length+changed.length+removed.length>0;return [{json:{initial,shouldArchive,websiteId:id,nextBaseline:{pages:next,at:new Date().toISOString()},changeSummary:{added,changed,removed},subject:'Lindo content '+(initial?'baseline':'changes')+': '+added.length+' added, '+changed.length+' changed, '+removed.length+' removed',report:[initial?'Initial content baseline':'Changes since '+previous.at,'Website: '+id,'Added: '+(added.join(', ')||'none'),'Changed: '+(changed.join(', ')||'none'),'Removed: '+(removed.join(', ')||'none'),'Removed means absent from the API inventory; confirm deletion in Lindo.'].join('\n')}}];
return [{json:{status:'unchanged',message:'No content changes; no Drive file or email created.'}}];

parameters.content: Use Header Auth Authorization = Bearer YOUR_LINDO_API_KEY in the three Lindo HTTP nodes. Configure website ID, private Drive folder and email addresses in Configure archive. Connect Drive OAuth and SMTP. Set schedule/timezone before activation.

SHA256 compares canonically ordered HTML, name/path, SEO, settings and custom codes. Added, changed and removed page names appear in the email and JSON archive. The first successful active run establishes the baseline; unchanged runs do not upload or email. API inventory removal is not proof of deliberate deletion.

State uses n8n workflow static data: only successful active trigger executions persist it; manual tests do not establish a durable baseline. Keep runs sequential and low frequency. Use a database or Data Table for concurrent/high-volume deployments. State commits only after downstream delivery succeeds; a failure can cause a repeated archive or notification on retry. Maximum 1000 page fingerprints. Full content remains in Drive, not static data.

Only API-visible agentic pages are captured. Blogs, media binaries, DNS and history are excluded; there is no automatic restore. Empty/incomplete inventories or blank HTML fail before altering the baseline. A 20 MB archive limit bounds memory use; manage Drive retention separately.
